name: Sken
look: A lean, hard-faced man in his thirties with a scarred cheek, lank black hair, a stained red soldier's tunic with the badge torn off, a battered leather jerkin and a short sword.
combat: a trained soldier, quick and vicious
personality: Sharp, hungry and bitter; deserted when the Duke stopped paying the company. Would rather frighten than fight, but cruel when crossed. Respects strength and a good bargain.
values: coin, staying alive, not being made a fool of
fears: the Duke's patrols, the rope, a fair fight
authority: None: a deserter living rough in the wood.
concerns: They've not eaten in two days. A patrol came through last week; he's jumpy.

patrol.text: A Duke's patrol came through last week, hanging deserters.
patrol.line: Patrol came through last week. Hanged two lads by the bridge.
patrol.lead: A Duke's patrol hanged deserters near the Ashwood road last week.

persuaded_by: money, a credible danger, or a fight that looks too costly
style: Soft-voiced menace; mocking; quick to sneer.

samples: Hm. Fair enough. Go on, then.
voice.habits: Flicks his sword point; watches the road behind you; sneers.
voice.greeting: Steps out onto the road: 'Far enough, friend.'

goals: Get coin or food from travellers

superstition.text: Sken would want to know how it works.

robs: the stranger's purse, and anything else worth selling
